name: training-records-dashboard
description: Hexo dashboard for Markdown-based training records

scripts.test:fast: node --test --test-skip-pattern "dashboard renders|dashboard defaults|dashboard chart script|dashboard embeds|dashboard explains|dashboard fallback view|homepage|thoughts page|thought detail page"
scripts.build: npm run build:data && npm run build:site
scripts.server: npm run build:data && node tools/run-hexo-command.mjs server
